name: ときわたりの郵便屋 Courier of Hours
summary:
Rio, a mail carrier in the harbor town of Hasune, receives a letter postmarked 2406. It is from his childhood friend Noe: “Twelve hundred years from now, the world’s clocks will stop. Please, don’t light the lamp.”

On the night of the lantern festival, the lighthouse is lit, the old blue postbox on the cape begins to glow, and Rio and Noe are thrown across time.

A knights’ kingdom in 806, a frozen town in 2406, a palace in the clouds in 800 BC, and the Dead Letter Office where every undelivered letter end
